about: 일반전표(E010201) 줄 구분 1출 · 2입 — 원본 2026-10-14 loginaa 실측: 1출 8109 11,000 → 줄 하나에 차 · 대 양쪽 11,000, 계정별원장 1019 현금 대 11,000 · 8109 차 11,000 / 2입 8109 5,000 → 차변을 건너뛰고 대변, 현금 차 5,000 · 8109 대 5,000. 우리 811 · 101 로 같은 분개 · 시산표 차이 → API 로 지워 되돌림. node qa/shot.mjs qa/flows/journal-entry-cash.json

shots.name: 일반전표 1출 · 2입 → 현금 상대 줄
steps: js:(async () => { const H = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const d = new Date(); const day = d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'); const get = async (p) => (await fetch('/api' + p, { headers: H })).json(); const tb = await get('/journals/trial-balance?from=' + day + '&to=' + day); const row = (c) => tb.rows.find((r) => r.accountCode === c) || { debit: 0, credit: 0 }; sessionStorage.setItem('jc-base', JSON.stringify({ d811: row('811').debit, c811: row('811').credit, d101: row('101').debit, c101: row('101').credit })); return sessionStorage.getItem('jc-base') })()

js:(async () => { const H = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const d = new Date(); const day = d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'); const get = async (p) => (await fetch('/api' + p, { headers: H })).json(); const j = await get('/journals?from=' + day + '&to=' + day); const e = j.rows.find((r) => r.sourceType === 'MANUAL' && r.description === 'QA회계1 1출' && r.totalDebit === 11000); sessionStorage.setItem('jc-out', String(e.id)); return e.docNo + ' ' + e.lines.map((l) => l.accountCode + ':' + l.debit + '/' + l.credit).join(',') })()

expect:(async () => { const H = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const d = new Date(); const day = d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'); const get = async (p) => (await fetch('/api' + p, { headers: H })).json(); const acc = (await get('/accounts')).find((a) => a.code === '101'); const l = await get('/journals/ledger?accountId=' + acc.id + '&from=' + day + '&to=' + day); return l.rows.some((r) => r.description === 'QA회계1 1출' && r.credit === 11000) && l.rows.some((r) => r.description === 'QA회계1 2입' && r.debit === 5000) })()

expect:(async () => { const H = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const d = new Date(); const day = d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'); const get = async (p) => (await fetch('/api' + p, { headers: H })).json(); const tb = await get('/journals/trial-balance?from=' + day + '&to=' + day); const row = (c) => tb.rows.find((r) => r.accountCode === c) || { debit: 0, credit: 0 }; const b = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('jc-base')); return row('811').debit - b.d811 === 11000 && row('811').credit - b.c811 === 5000 && row('101').debit - b.d101 === 5000 && row('101').credit - b.c101 === 11000 })()
